title: 美国节日食品价格上行 家庭预算承压
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Grocery prices. Yeah, it's just in the last three weeks. Yeah, I look at it. You're kidding me. Exactly.
segments.zh: 食品杂货价格。是的，就在过去三周。我看了下。你开玩笑吧。没错。

segments.en: I mean, they haven't come down at all. There was a surge of food inflation in October that economists attribute to this year's spike in energy costs, which are now making it to the grocery
segments.zh: 它们根本没降下来。10月食品通胀飙升，经济学家归因于今年能源成本上涨，现在正传导到杂货货架。

segments.en: aisle. There's so much higher. It's harder to make ends meet. I've noticed the box of pasta has gone up. The meat department has gone up. Economists expect food prices to remain elevated through
segments.zh: 价格高太多了，日子更难过了。我注意到一盒意面涨价了，肉类区也涨了。经济学家预计食品价格将高位持续到假期并进入2027年。

segments.en: the holidays and into 2027. Lower Raider of Columbus says it's harder to make ends meet with the higher food prices, but she's not letting that affect her traditional holiday meals.
segments.zh: 哥伦布的Lower Raider说，食品价格上涨让日子更难过了，但她不会让这影响传统的节日大餐。

segments.en: I want to keep Christmas and Thanksgiving the same with like good quality stuff and just like things that we've always enjoyed. So it's probably just going to have to be something
segments.zh: 我想让圣诞和感恩节保持原样，用优质的东西，就像我们一直享受的那样。所以可能只是得成为我们预算里的一项，试着从别处补回来。

segments.en: we budget for and try to like make the difference somewhere else.
segments.zh: 我们做预算，试着从别的地方弥补差价。

segments.en: Ruth Ann Taber of Columbus isn't cutting back on her baking, but isn't happy about having to pay higher food prices. Kind of resigned to paying the what I have to pay if I want the product.
segments.zh: 哥伦布的Ruth Ann Taber没有减少烘焙，但对不得不支付更高的食品价格感到不满。有点无奈，如果想要产品，就得付我该付的。
